about_the_game:
A mystery point-and-click adventure about recovering lost memories and uncovering the secrets of a mystical hospital.

You are Willow, a 13-year-old girl awakening in a twisted realm. Your brother is lost, your heart is heavy, and your resolve to find him is as strong as ever.

Welcome to the Interim.

Explore a hospital where time and reality drift out of place, solve atmospheric puzzles, and face moral choices that shape who you become — a compassionate guide for others, or a lone survivor.

Speak with unsettling yet well-meaning patients, learn their stories, and venture deeper into ever-changing halls. Gather forgotten memories and make your way toward the heart of the hospital, where something important has been waiting for you all along.

Wander and Remember

Experience classic point-and-click storytelling, where progress comes from observation, curiosity, and clever use of found objects.

Encounter a variety of whimsical mini-games: duel a knight made of junk, play wolves a lullaby, or help a blind girl mend her broken mirror.

Use your imagination. In a world where memories shape reality, puzzles often demand faith in the impossible to be solved.

Collect memories of your journey in the form of photographs. Some moments fade… and some may hold more power than they seem.
